segments.text: Respect the lab and respect your colleagues.
segments.zh: 尊重实验室，也尊重你的同事。

segments.text: Your behavior goes a long way to ensuring that the lab is a safe environment for everyone.
segments.zh: 你的行为对确保实验室对每个人都是安全的环境有着重要作用。

segments.text: The first consideration is to follow the written standard operating procedures, step by step.
segments.zh: 首先要考虑的是，按照书面的标准操作规程，一步一步地操作。

segments.text: Never eat, drink, chew gum, or apply makeup while in the lab.
segments.zh: 在实验室里绝不要吃东西、喝水、嚼口香糖或化妆。

segments.text: You don't want to contaminate your skin or risk ingesting poisonous chemicals.
segments.zh: 你不希望污染自己的皮肤，或冒着误食有毒化学品的风险。

segments.text: You could also contaminate your experiment and ruin the results.
segments.zh: 你还可能污染你的实验，毁掉实验结果。

segments.text: Never work alone.
segments.zh: 绝不要独自工作。

segments.text: Always have at least one other person in the lab so that you can help each other in case of an emergency.
segments.zh: 实验室里始终至少要有另外一个人，这样遇到紧急情况时可以互相帮助。

segments.text: Good housekeeping will prevent accidents too.
segments.zh: 良好的整理整顿也能预防事故。

segments.text: A cluttered lab is a dangerous lab.
segments.zh: 杂乱的实验室就是危险的实验室。

segments.text: Dispose of any trash or debris on the floor which could cause someone to fall.
segments.zh: 清理地面上任何可能让人摔倒的垃圾或杂物。

segments.text: Never place any chemical bottles on the floor, not even temporarily.
segments.zh: 绝不要把任何化学品瓶放在地上，哪怕是暂时的也不行。

segments.text: If you do make a spill, check the safety data sheet for the appropriate response.
segments.zh: 如果你确实洒出了东西，请查看安全技术说明书，了解适当的应对方法。

segments.text: For a routine spill, clean it immediately and place a wet floor sign.
segments.zh: 对于常规的泄漏，要立即清理，并放置“小心地滑”的标志。

segments.text: Keep your workbench clean and organized.
segments.zh: 保持实验台干净整齐。

segments.text: Have only the materials you need.
segments.zh: 只放你需要的材料。

segments.text: Store away all unneeded items.
segments.zh: 把所有不需要的物品收起来。

segments.text: Don't place materials near the edge of the workbench where they can easily be knocked off.
segments.zh: 不要把材料放在实验台边缘，那里很容易被碰落。

segments.text: Never try to pick up broken glass with your bare hands.
segments.zh: 绝不要徒手去捡碎玻璃。

segments.text: A cut or puncture caused by broken glass may introduce a hazardous chemical directly into your bloodstream.
segments.zh: 碎玻璃造成的割伤或刺伤，可能会把危险化学品直接带入你的血液。

segments.text: Dispose the glass in a designated broken glass container.
segments.zh: 把玻璃丢弃到指定的碎玻璃收集容器中。

segments.text: After you've finished an experiment, wash and dry glassware.
segments.zh: 完成实验后，清洗并晾干玻璃器皿。

segments.text: Return reagents to the storage area and clean the workbench surface with ethanol or isopropyl alcohol.
segments.zh: 把试剂放回储存区，并用乙醇或异丙醇擦拭实验台台面。

segments.text: If a safety violation occurs or you notice any unsafe condition in the lab, report it immediately to your supervisor.
segments.zh: 如果发生违反安全规定的情况，或者你注意到实验室里有任何不安全的状况，请立即向你的主管报告。

segments.text: Be on your best behavior.
segments.zh: 拿出你最好的表现。

segments.text: In our next lesson, we'll look at some specific chemical hazards that are common in laboratories.
segments.zh: 在下一课中，我们将了解实验室中常见的一些具体化学危害。
